targeted_findings.semantic_change: Expected oracle and conformance material is removed from the orchestration catalog and stored in a separate scorer-only catalog; run-facing records contain only sanitized arm material.
validation_performed: no scorer-only fields in sanitized catalog
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: A future harness must still compare manifest field paths to the selected allowlist; this slice does not implement that harness.

targeted_findings.semantic_change: A-style qualified projections are deterministic only under the named map and retain the native C axes.
validation_performed: no unconditional NO_EFFECT_OBSERVED to non-occurrence rule
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: Profile-specific evidence thresholds still require later implementation and conformance testing.

validation_performed: invalid dispatch plus supported occurrence representable
targeted_findings.residual_limitation: The schema does not itself evaluate Ananke authority policy.

targeted_findings.semantic_change: Experiment and verifier/result links use typed references with record type and schema identity.

targeted_findings.residual_limitation: Cross-record equality of duplicated IDs requires future verifier/scorer checks.

stage is a recognized C binding
